sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: NATO takes command across the south
geopolitical_news.summary: ISAF assumes control of southern provinces as the Taliban insurgency intensifies sharply.

geopolitical_news.headline: Operation Medusa in Kandahar
geopolitical_news.summary: Major NATO-Canadian offensive targets Taliban strongholds in Panjwaii district.

sport.headline: Cricketers climb world ranks
sport.summary: The national cricket team rises through ICC divisions, building toward full recognition.

geopolitical_news.headline: Taliban kidnap South Korean missionaries
geopolitical_news.summary: Twenty-three aid workers seized in Ghazni; two are killed before a deal frees the rest.

geopolitical_news.headline: Suicide bombings surge nationwide
geopolitical_news.summary: A record wave of Taliban bomb attacks hits Kabul and the provinces.

sport.headline: Footballers eye regional stage
sport.summary: The national football team competes in South Asian qualifiers amid growing domestic interest.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kabul hotel and embassy bombings
geopolitical_news.summary: Deadly attacks on the Serena Hotel and Indian embassy signal the insurgency's reach.

geopolitical_news.headline: US weighs troop surge
geopolitical_news.summary: Washington debates reinforcements as violence reaches its worst level since 2001.

sport.headline: Nikpai wins historic Olympic bronze
sport.summary: Taekwondo fighter Rohullah Nikpai takes bronze in Beijing, Afghanistan's first Olympic medal.

geopolitical_news.headline: Obama orders troop surge
geopolitical_news.summary: Thirty thousand extra US troops deploy under a new counterinsurgency strategy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Fraud mars presidential election
geopolitical_news.summary: Hamid Karzai is declared winner after a runoff is abandoned over massive fraud.

sport.headline: Cricket team earns ODI status
sport.summary: Strong World Cup qualifying results secure one-day international status for Afghanistan.

geopolitical_news.headline: Marjah offensive launched
geopolitical_news.summary: Thousands of US, British and Afghan troops assault the Taliban hub in Helmand.

geopolitical_news.headline: War logs leak
geopolitical_news.summary: WikiLeaks publishes tens of thousands of classified US military documents on the war.

sport.headline: Asian Games cricket silver
sport.summary: Afghanistan reaches the cricket final in Guangzhou, losing to Bangladesh.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bin Laden killed in Pakistan
geopolitical_news.summary: The al-Qaeda leader's death across the border reshapes the war's rationale.

geopolitical_news.headline: US begins troop drawdown
geopolitical_news.summary: Obama announces phased withdrawals as peace envoy Rabbani is assassinated.

sport.headline: Cricketers win World League Division One
sport.summary: Victory in the ICC division secures a path toward the 2015 World Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: Quran burning sparks deadly protests
geopolitical_news.summary: US troops' burning of Qurans triggers nationwide riots and insider attacks.

geopolitical_news.headline: Strategic pact signed with US
geopolitical_news.summary: Kabul and Washington agree a long-term partnership beyond the 2014 withdrawal.

sport.headline: World T20 debut in Sri Lanka
sport.summary: Afghanistan competes at the ICC World Twenty20, its first global tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Afghans take security lead
geopolitical_news.summary: NATO hands combat leadership to Afghan forces as the 2014 exit nears.

geopolitical_news.headline: Taliban office opens in Doha
geopolitical_news.summary: A political office in Qatar opens a channel for future peace talks.

sport.headline: SAFF Championship triumph
sport.summary: Afghanistan beats India in the final to win the South Asian football title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ghani wins disputed election
geopolitical_news.summary: A US-brokered unity deal makes Ashraf Ghani president after a bitter runoff.

geopolitical_news.headline: NATO combat mission ends
geopolitical_news.summary: ISAF formally closes as Afghan forces assume full responsibility for security.

sport.headline: Cricketers stun Bangladesh in Asia Cup
sport.summary: A 32-run win over Bangladesh marks Afghanistan's first victory against a Test nation.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kunduz falls to the Taliban
geopolitical_news.summary: Insurgents briefly seize a major city, their biggest gain since 2001.

geopolitical_news.headline: US hospital bombing in Kunduz
geopolitical_news.summary: An American airstrike destroys an MSF hospital, killing dozens of patients and staff.

sport.headline: World Cup debut Down Under
sport.summary: Afghanistan plays its first Cricket World Cup, beating Scotland for a maiden win.

geopolitical_news.headline: Battle for Kunduz rages again
geopolitical_news.summary: Taliban fighters storm the northern city a second time before being repelled.

geopolitical_news.headline: Peace deal with Hekmatyar
geopolitical_news.summary: Warlord Gulbuddin Hekmatyar signs an accord and returns to Kabul.

sport.headline: Cricketers stun West Indies at World T20
sport.summary: A famous six-run win over the eventual champions in Nagpur delights fans.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trump unveils new war strategy
geopolitical_news.summary: Washington commits more troops with no timeline, pressuring Pakistan on sanctuaries.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kabul truck bomb devastates district
geopolitical_news.summary: A massive blast in the diplomatic quarter kills scores and wounds hundreds.

sport.headline: Afghanistan granted Test status
sport.summary: The ICC awards full membership, elevating the team to cricket's top tier.

geopolitical_news.headline: Parliamentary elections held
geopolitical_news.summary: Long-delayed polls proceed amid Taliban attacks on voters and polling stations.

geopolitical_news.headline: Khalilzad appointed US envoy
geopolitical_news.summary: Zalmay Khalilzad is tasked with driving direct talks with the Taliban.

sport.headline: Historic debut Test against India
sport.summary: Afghanistan plays its first Test match, in Bengaluru against India.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ghani re-elected amid fraud claims
geopolitical_news.summary: A low-turnout presidential poll returns Ghani to office; rivals reject the result.

geopolitical_news.headline: US-Taliban talks collapse
geopolitical_news.summary: Trump abruptly cancels negotiations after a bombing kills an American soldier.

sport.headline: World Cup campaign in England
sport.summary: Afghanistan competes at the Cricket World Cup, pushing several top sides close.

geopolitical_news.headline: US-Taliban deal signed in Doha
geopolitical_news.summary: February accord sets a timetable for full American withdrawal from Afghanistan.

geopolitical_news.headline: Intra-Afghan talks open
geopolitical_news.summary: Government and Taliban negotiators meet in Doha, but violence continues.

sport.headline: Cricket survives the pandemic pause
sport.summary: Domestic and international fixtures resume behind closed doors after COVID halts play.

geopolitical_news.headline: Taliban seize Kabul
geopolitical_news.summary: The government collapses on August 15 as insurgents sweep into the capital.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kabul airport bombing
geopolitical_news.summary: An ISIS-K suicide attack during the evacuation kills US troops and scores of Afghans.

sport.headline: Cricketers play on amid turmoil
sport.summary: The team competes at the T20 World Cup weeks after the Taliban takeover.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economy collapses under sanctions
geopolitical_news.summary: Frozen reserves and halted aid push millions toward hunger and poverty.

geopolitical_news.headline: Girls' schools stay shut
geopolitical_news.summary: The Taliban reneges on reopening secondary schools for girls, drawing global condemnation.

sport.headline: Asia Cup Super Four run
sport.summary: Afghanistan reaches the Super Four stage of the T20 Asia Cup in the UAE.

geopolitical_news.headline: Women banned from universities
geopolitical_news.summary: The Taliban extends education bans, barring women from higher education and NGOs.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly Herat earthquakes
geopolitical_news.summary: A series of powerful quakes devastates villages in western Afghanistan.

sport.headline: World Cup upsets in India
sport.summary: Afghanistan stuns England and Pakistan at the ODI World Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: Morality law tightens control
geopolitical_news.summary: New vice-and-virtue laws further restrict women's public life and freedoms.

geopolitical_news.headline: Taliban join Doha talks
geopolitical_news.summary: Kabul's rulers attend UN-led talks, seeking engagement without concessions.

sport.headline: T20 World Cup semifinal run
sport.summary: Afghanistan beats Australia and reaches a first-ever World Cup semifinal.

geopolitical_news.headline: Border clashes with Pakistan
geopolitical_news.summary: Cross-border fighting erupts as ties between Kabul and Islamabad deteriorate.

geopolitical_news.headline: Women's rights curbs deepen
geopolitical_news.summary: New decrees further squeeze women's access to work, education and public space.

sport.headline: Champions Trophy semifinal
sport.summary: Afghanistan reaches the semifinals, beating England along the way.
